text_block_list.text:
One day, thinking I heard Grass Wonder's 
voice, I headed to the gymnasium, where—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Seiyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I was honing my fighting 
spirit. Preparing for the impending 
battle.

Grass Wonder's extraordinary fighting 
spirit... Just what is she preparing to 
battle against...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, you've arrived.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Grass... Judging by your demeanor, you 
seem thoroughly prepared.
choice_data_list: Wait, are you going to fight Air Groove!?
Wait, are you going to fight Air Groove!?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
With Air Groove-senpai...? No, she shows 
me the way—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: She's my pest extermination master.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will thoroughly exterminate the 
pests that have infested the Miho 
Dormitory flowerbeds.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Because of those people, the flowers I was 
growing for flower arrangement have been 
ruined— I cannot forgive this!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I sympathize with your plight, Grass. I 
shall thoroughly teach you the ABCs of 
extermination that I possess.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Senpai. I look 
forward to your guidance and mentorship!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
They are geniuses at deceiving our eyes. 
Sense them with their presence, not your 
sight.
choice_data_list: (This is a guide to pest control...!?)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —There! ...Wait, they're gone?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Look closely, they're behind the stems. 
Let even one get away, and it'll cause 
trouble by multiplying all over again!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Now, picture the hated pests. Cherish the 
flowers, take care not to harm them... and 
strike!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I will... protect it!

And so, the grueling, intense special 
training continued, until the time for the 
decisive battle finally arrived—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"This is the flowerbed in question. Now 
then, where is the mortal enemy—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...The sound of wings!? Dodge, Trainer!"
choice_data_list: Kuh... Huh? Where'd the bug go?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It has been dealt with, so please rest 
assured. Please stay back.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What deft technique... Grass... did you 
pull it off?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I shall eradicate only the pests 
without harming the flowers—here I come.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A form where you swat the bug away with a 
knifehand strike and instantly bag it for 
disposal. It is my original technique: 
"Flower-Guarding Pest Extermination 
Stance."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The stem, the underside of leaves, deep 
inside petals. No matter where they hide, 
it makes no difference!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes, one! Two! Three! Over here too!
choice_data_list: Movement smooth as flowing water... Ah!

text_block_list.text:
I could hardly believe my eyes at the 
impossible sight. Grass Wonder's maneuvers 
looked like the fluid strikes of a 
naginata...!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now then, this concludes the sideshow. 
...Prepare yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Teryaaaahhh—!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
For the blossom I must protect... Forgive 
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Looking at you has reawakened it. 
My pride as a gardener, that is.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I'm going to inspect the flowerbeds 
around Ritto. ...Don't let your guard 
down, Grass."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for everything. Please leave 
this to me.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We will restore peace to Miho's flower 
beds without fail. Good luck to you as 
well, Air Groove-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hm! A survivor headed your way! Stay on 
your guard!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...I let my guard down. I shall humbly 
accept this as punishment for my conceit."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I shall eradicate them completely. En 
garde!
